name: reframe
description: Universal typed-graph engine — import, audit, transform, export. Design and knowledge as first-class domains.

scripts.dev: cross-env REFRAME_HTTP_FORCE=1 npx tsx watch --clear-screen=false packages/mcp/src/tests/start-sidecar.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:editor && npm run build:editor-bundle
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npx tsx scripts/test-pipeline.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-reframe-all.ts && npx tsx scripts/test-scene-import-parity.ts

author: Ilya Makarov
